query: INSERT INTO accounts (account_id, login, notify_email, is_admin, state, cred_gen, created) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET login = excluded.login, notify_email = excluded.notify_email, is_admin = excluded.is_admin, state = excluded.state, cred_gen = excluded.cred_gen, created = excluded.created
